meta.name: V4 Data Organization R01
meta.objective: Inventory the current live and local V4 artifacts, separate paper-audit assets from native conceptual-study surfaces, identify which conceptual setups can run now versus which are blocked on missing bundle/spec work, and produce implementation-facing manifests/docs for the next launch phase.

compile.baseHint: Use the current live Convex catalog and local V4 source/build artifacts as the inventory baseline, then write repeatable export surfaces and a human-readable readiness split.
taskSignals: The paper-audit launch lane is already complete and should be treated as a closed baseline.
The user wants native conceptual setups to be considered next, but only after the data is organized.
The repo already has local source/build bundles plus live experiment state, so the missing layer is inventory/readiness, not another launch runner.
notes: No subagents were required; the bounded work is a local export plus synthesis/documentation pass.

stopConditions: Stop when the inventory export exists, the human-readable data split exists, and the next conceptual queue is explicit.

budget.provider_budget_policy: GPT-4.1 only for upcoming conceptual launches
